description: Catálogo de la red regional de carreteras (tramificada) is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. El catálogo incluye los tramos de la red complementaria preferente, de la red complementaria local y de la red básica. Coverage: Castilla y León. The portal files it under Urban planning and infrastructures. Its keywords are carreteras, bienes inmuebles, información patrimonial. The portal shows 160 records. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
